semantic_slots.name: ambient_space_and_coordinates
semantic_slots.content: E is a real normed vector space; d is any natural number; e is an algebraic real-linear bijection from E to Euclidean R^d, not assumed isometric. E has finite dimension d.

semantic_slots.name: function_and_properness
semantic_slots.content: f maps E to EReal; f never takes bottom and has at least one finite real value globally.

semantic_slots.name: set_and_domain
semantic_slots.content: V is convex and contained in {x | f(x) < top}. Together with properness, this makes f finite on V.

semantic_slots.name: curvature
semantic_slots.content: lambda >= 0 and for all x,y in V and 0 < a < 1, f(a*x+(1-a)*y) <= a*f(x)+(1-a)*f(y)-(lambda/2)*a*(1-a)*norm_E(x-y)^2.

semantic_slots.name: base_point
semantic_slots.content: p is any point of V; no interior, differentiability or optimality hypothesis.

semantic_slots.name: coordinate_global_support
semantic_slots.content: g is any Euclidean coordinate vector with global support: for every z in E, f(p)+inner(g,e(z-p)) <= f(z), in EReal. This is assumed, not proved to exist.

semantic_slots.name: comparison_and_conclusion
semantic_slots.content: For every q in V, toReal(f(p))+inner(g,e(q-p))+(lambda/2)*norm_E(q-p)^2 <= toReal(f(q)), in the reals.

global_support_quantifier: all coordinate u in R^d, equivalently all z in E, including outside V
norm_role: original E norm in both quadratic terms
pairing_role: standard Euclidean pairing of g with e(q-p)
finite_infinite_domains: effectiveDomain alone permits bottom, but SourceProper rules bottom out globally; top is allowed outside V; all f-values on V are finite
asserted_conclusion: real quadratic supporting inequality on V
derived_facts: V nonempty once p in V is supplied

boundaries.d_zero: E and R^0 are singletons; p=q, g=0, conclusion equality; any nonnegative lambda allowed
boundaries.lambda_zero: conclusion is the supplied linear support inequality at q; no positive curvature guaranteed
boundaries.empty_V: no p in V can be supplied
boundaries.empty_subdifferential: no admissible g can be supplied

not_guaranteed: existence or uniqueness of a subgradient
ambiguities: The request gives no canonical names for the seven slots; the explicit partition in this artifact supplies organizational labels only.
